title: Generative AI for EveryOne-Professionals and Leaders
_comment_overview: PARAPHRASED from the krishnaik.in landing page and the learn.krishnaikacademy.com checkout page — never copy marketing prose verbatim. Facts (fee, duration, schedule, tool names, mentors, audience) are used as-is.
overview: A 2-2.5 month live, 100% no-code generative AI program for professionals and leaders who want to apply AI immediately without writing code. Saturday and Sunday evening sessions led by Krish Naik and Mayank Agarwal cover practical use of tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT, Jasper, Grammarly, Zapier, Make and n8n for content creation, data analysis, research and workflow automation. It is aimed at engineers, product managers, sales/marketing/HR leaders, consultants, entrepreneurs and operations managers who want to lead AI adoption strategically rather than write code themselves.
_comment_category: Primary reflects the course's core: applying generative AI assistants and no-code tools end to end for professional productivity. 'Analytics' secondary for the dedicated data-analysis tooling (Julius, Tableau AI) under 'Data Analysis with AI'. No 'Agentic AI' secondary added (unlike the sibling no-code course) — this page names Zapier/Make/n8n only as workflow-automation tools, with no explicit AI-agent-building module called out on the page as curated here.
_comment_level: Page explicitly markets to 'first-time AI users' and 'non-technical' professionals with no prerequisites, so beginner is the honest fusion anchor. level_range extends to intermediate because the workflow-automation and AI-workflow-development modules (multi-step automations, custom business solutions) require more structured technical thinking than the earlier tool-usage modules — stored only, not scored per schema §1, matching the same pattern used for the sibling no-code course.
_comment_price: ₹6500.00 stated inclusive of GST on both the krishnaik.in landing page and the learn.krishnaikacademy.com checkout page — fixed price, not coupon-driven, so a number is safe here. price_band 'mid' per schema §2 (₹3,000-₹9,999).
_comment_rating: No star rating or review count published on either source page. Null, not guessed — the validator's null-rating warning is expected.

format._comment_cohort_start: Page states 'Start Date: September 14, 2025' / 'September 14th 2025'. Curation date is 2026-08-06 — that date is roughly 11 months in the past, so per schema §3 it CANNOT sit in format.cohort_start (generate would wrongly tell a user today to enrol for a cohort that already started and finished nearly a year ago). Moved to top-level cohort_start_stale. No next-cohort date is published, so cohort_start stays null; per §6 this demotes the freshness mode prior from 'live' (1.00) to the 'recorded' prior (0.45) until a future cohort_start is captured.
format._comment_enrollment_status: Both source pages show active 'Enroll Now' CTAs and a stated fee despite the started/finished cohort — read as open enrollment (likely a rolling next batch), matching the same reasoning used for modern-no-code-ai-route-ai-generalist-to-ai-builder.
format._comment_schedule: Both source pages consistently state '8 Pm to 10 Pm' / '8 PM to 10 PM IST' — a 2-hour weekend evening slot, distinct from the 8-11pm slot used by several sibling courses. No discrepancy between the two sources here.
format._comment_duration: Top badge on the landing page says '2-2.5 Months'; the checkout-page course-overview block separately states 'Duration : 2-3 months'. Stored the landing-page badge figure as primary per the same convention used for agentic-ai-agentops-bootcamp-3-0; the gap is listing softness, not a version skew.
format._comment_dates: No publish or 'last updated' date is published on either source. Both null rather than guessed. Recency falls through to cohort_start_stale (2025-09-14) under §6's fallback chain.
format._comment_curriculum_version: No version string published for this course. Null per §7 rather than inventing one.
